grants.needs: nothing for this user's processes; elevation for all
grants.why: OpenProcess on another user's process needs an elevated token
GetExtendedTcpTable returns owning pids machine-wide only when elevated

grants.how: auditpol /set /subcategory:"Process Creation" /success:enable /failure:enable   (also User Account Management, Sensitive Privilege Use)
grants.needs: elevated token AND Advanced Audit Policy
grants.plane: agent actions (C), process and identity events
grants.why: the Security channel carries nothing until the subcategories are on
without it lineage still works and every argument-vector tactic goes undetected, which is most of them

grants.how: set an audit ACE on the credential paths you care about
grants.needs: a SACL on each audited object
grants.why: event 4663 is only emitted for objects with an audit ACE, so credential reads and persistence writes are not observable without one
